technom.research_page.ADVDECONTABLE.1: The Advanced Deconstruction Table breaks an object down into pure primal knowledge. Place an object on it and it slowly grinds it apart; every so often the process yields one point of a primal aspect directly into your research pool, chosen from the primals that object was made of. The rarer the object, the longer it lasts. Install a Potency Gem with a shift-right-click to halve the time it takes; shift-right-click with an empty hand to take the gem back.
technom.research_page.CONDENSER.1: Too much power is never a bad thing, and now you've got a machine to put it to good use. By hooking up an Energy Condenser to some conduits, you can turn Forge Energy (Q) into some Potentia. The Potentia can then easily be piped out of the condenser into your favorite jar. The energy cost of one Potentia is set by the condenserCostQ config value (200,000 Q by default).
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.1: After studying the way the Arcane Bore and Infernal Furnace draw essentia for power, you've decided to make your own spinoff using Forge Energy. By hooking the Essentia Dynamo to a series of pipes and wires, you can take essentia and turn it into Forge Energy (Q). Some aspects carry more energy than others and last longer, producing more power. How the Essentia Dynamo answers a redstone signal can be reconfigured in place.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.2: Right clicking on the Dynamo with a Redstone Torch will cause the Dynamo to be disabled by a redstone signal, Gunpowder will make it ignore redstone, and Redstone Dust will return it to its original behavior. The dynamo can be rotated using most wrenches.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.4: You have also discovered that Dynamos can have their power output increased at the cost of fuel consumption. By right clicking on the Dynamo with a Potency Gem, the Dynamo will output four times the power, but will also consume four times the fuel. Shift Right clicking on the Dynamo with an empty hand will remove the Potency Gem.
technom.research_page.ELDRITCHCONSUMER.1: The Eldritch Consumer is a hungry pit. Put it above a drop, a mob farm or an ore vein and feed it Forge Energy: each item, mob or block it destroys costs one charge and leaves behind the aspect that object was made of, which tubes and jars can pull out. Sneak-click it to step through its six working volumes, from a one-block pit to a 33x33 hole that reaches bedrock. It will not touch unbreakable blocks or anything holding a block entity, and a block it breaks yields its aspect but not its drops.
technom.research_page.ESSENTIAFUSOR.1: While breaking Essentia down into its components is useful, you have been searching for a way to reverse the process in the hopes of creating some of the more hard to find Essentia. Combining the Alchemical Centirfuge with some magic infused technology has finally provided the answer, the Essentia Fusor. The Fusor can be "programmed" with an Essentia recipe, and when provided with Essentia and power will create compound Essentia. To program the Fusor, right-click on two of the red points on the top of the Fusor with filled Essentia Phials that contain the Essentia types you wish to combine. Essentia that can not be combined will not be accepted.
technom.research_page.ESSENTIAFUSOR.2: Marking a side in this way will allow Essentia of that type to be accepted by that side. To mark the side to output the new Essentia to, right-click on another point with an empty Phial. Only two input sides and one output side can be marked at a time. If done correctly, the symbol for the desired Essentia should appear in the center of the Fusor. To remove a Phial from the Fusor, just right-click on it with an empty hand. Note that if the Fusor contains any Essentia of that type, or any Essentia of the output type, you will not be able to remove the Phial until the excess Essentia has been removed. By default the Fusor requires a redstone signal to operate, but this behavior can be modified in a way similar to the Dynamos.
technom.research_page.FUSIONFOCUS.1: A wand focus that treats a node as something you can pour. Use it on an aura node or a jarred node and the focus remembers it - that costs nothing. Use it on a second node and the first one's vis, and the capacity that holds it, are moved into the second in a single transaction, for 30 vis of every primal. Whatever does not fit stays behind, and a source that gives everything away is left as nothing at all.
technom.research_page.FUSIONFOCUS.2: Creating a node out of nothing is beyond this version: Thaumcraft's public node interface can only change nodes that already exist, so the focus moves vis between them instead of conjuring a new one. The selection is kept on the wand that carries the focus, so two thaumaturges never share one.
technom.research_page.NODEDYNAMO.1: Continuing your research into magical energy, you have realised that the vis of a node is not unlike the essentia held in items. A Node Dynamo drains one vis at a time from aura nodes and jarred nodes within four blocks, never taking the last point of an aspect, and burns it into Forge Energy through its output face. Its redstone behaviour, potency gem and rotation work exactly as on the Essentia Dynamo.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.1: Converting magic to energy is easy enough, but the other way around is far more difficult and expensive.<LINE>Construction: two Fabricators need five blocks of space between them and must face each other. Each one builds an invisible 1x3x3 frame around itself; anything solid in the way simply leaves the frame unbuilt.<LINE>Essentia: Fabricators draw essentia through any face of that frame except the one they look through, from jars and tubes whose suction is lower than their own - which is why an unlabelled jar gives and a labelled jar of a different aspect does not.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.2: Recharging a node: the node belongs one block above ground level, centred between the two Fabricators. Each 1000 Q and one unit of essentia puts one vis back into an aspect the node already has, never past its maximum.<LINE>Adding aspects to a node: with a potency gem installed, 10000 Q and ten units raise an aspect's maximum by one and fill that point, which is also how an aspect the node never had is introduced.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.3: Node creation is not available in this version. Thaumcraft's public node interface can only change a node that already exists, so the wand-triggered ritual that used to build one out of aurum and vitium - and the essentia intake that fed it - are deliberately absent rather than half-working.
technom.research_page.PEN.1: Do you realize how stupid you are to use an ink and quill all this time? I mean, you've got frickin' wands that shoot frickin' lightning bolts and machines that make energy out of MAGIC for Pete's sake. Has it seriously taken you this long just to make a pen? The answer is yes, yes it has. But now you have a pen to use instead of that stupid inkwell: 3000 uses of ink, and clicking one of two adjacent tables with it builds the research table.
technom.research_page.PROCESSOR.1: You've been hunting down a way to increase your ore output without using silly purification methods, and now you've found one. By placing blocks in the left slot and adding Ignis essentia, you've successfully acquired ore doubling through purification. These new purified ores can be processed through other magical devices similar to this one to increase ore output further, but each device can only purify an ore twice. To obtain the ingots after the ore has been processed as many times as desired, throw the purified ore into a furnace in order to cook it.
technom.research_page.QUANTUMJARS.1: You have discovered a way to use the power of the almighty science to cram more essentia into a jar. This new jar uses quantum mechanics to increase its maximum storage capacity and therefore can be a bit unstable. The quantum jar is a bit more intelligent and has a higher suction rate than unlabeled warded jars and its suction increases depending on the amount of essentia within it.
technom.research_page.ROD_electric.1: Infusing a normal silverwood wand core with some energy and machines gives it special properties at the cost of its vis storage. With any Forge Energy battery in your inventory, the wand draws energy from it to refill its own vis storage at 100 Q per centivis, that is 10000 Q for one whole vis of a primal aspect. This wand can store 25 vis of each primal.
technom.research_page.TECHNOBASICS.1: After a series of scientific discoveries, you've figured out ways to incorporate your pre-existing electronics into your new magical discoveries unlocking some new basic materials.
technom.research_page.TECHNOTURGESCEPTER: After struggling with the low storage of the Energized Wand, you have started experimenting with ways to increase this capacity. No matter what you try, you always end up with a rod which is too big for normal use as a wand. But now that you have mastered scepters, you realise these failed experiments would make a perfect scepter core! The Technoturges Scepter holds 150 vis of each primal and recharges from a wand recharge pedestal or from any Forge Energy source, at 100 Q per centivis.

Assembly is Thaumcraft's own scepter recipe: three identical wand caps, a thaumic charm and the Technoturges core, which also means it needs the Scepters research. The scepter counts as a wrench on Technomancy machines; the 1.7.10 version's wrench support for other mods and its block-rotation gestures are not part of this port.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.1: After realizing how poorly essentia tubes work, you decide to switch over to a new wireless method that is much more refined. Use a Coil Coupler on an Essentia Coil, then on any jar or other essentia store, to link the coil to it. Once linked, the coil draws from its sources into whatever it is attached to until that is full. A coil holds up to 16 links, each within 32 blocks of it, and a source may feed any number of coils. Click a linked source again to unlink it, or sneak-click the coil with the coupler to clear every link. Apply a printed jar label to filter the coil to one aspect; sneak-click it with an empty hand to take the label back.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.2: The coil does not only push. Machines that pull essentia for themselves, such as the Thaumatorium, the Arcane Bore or an Arcane Lamp, can draw straight from a coil placed against them as if it were a tube, and the coil fetches whatever they ask for from its linked sources. An Essentia Buffer between coil and machine remains a safe interface for anything that neither accepts pushed essentia nor pulls it on its own.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.3: A coil only works while it receives no redstone signal; program it with redstone, a redstone torch or gunpowder like other machines. Install a Potency Gem and the coil instead emits a redstone signal while the block it feeds still has room, ignoring redstone itself. Sneak-click it with an empty hand to take the gem back once the label is gone.
